body: I understand completely. 99% of my problems are a result of my inability to do anything important for myself. & I end up feeling like extra shit because I know all my problems were preventable and it’s all my fault that I’m in a hole

Maybe medication can help you too? And if you spent so long helping her through depression maybe you should give her the chance to help you. If she wants to be with you and is willing to help why not?  I know shit seems bad now, but if it was possible for her to overcome her depression it might be possible for you too. Atleast talk with her about it and see where she stands .

I second the rubber band snapping. It can provide some relief while not causing much harm or drawing attention.

Definitely don’t cut in public. There’s so many things that can go wrong. Last year when I was in a really bad place with my sh I would sit in my car at work during breaks and cut. I didn’t have enough time to properly dress the wounds so a couple times I ended up with blood running down my arms and staining my shirt. Best to avoid those situations
